meta.name: host-observer
meta.description: Use this when fulfilling claude-mem observer jobs on Grok Bot: reply only skip_summary or one full observation XML, never prose.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行Grok Bot的记忆观察任务,只输出标准总结或完整观测结果。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要让机器人按规范格式输出记忆观察结果。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a bot to report memory observations in a structured format.

howto.what: 装上后,它在 claude-mem 观察者任务里的回复被限制成两种:要么是 `<skip_summary reason="noise" />`,要么是一条完整的 `<observation>` XML(真实标题、4–10 条带路径的事实和叙述)。散文式回复会被丢弃。
howto.when: 在 Grok Bot 上执行 claude-mem 观察者任务时接管:任务闲置、初始化、没有工具结果,或刚完成一个可检索单元时。

say.text: 这次没内容可记,直接跳过
say.note: 它会返回 skip_summary,不写正文

say.text: 把刚才那个修复整理成一条 observation
say.note: 输出带标题和事实清单的 XML

say.text: 这条写成 feature 类型,事实要带文件路径

howto.what_en: After install, its replies in claude-mem observer jobs are limited to two forms: `<skip_summary reason="noise" />` or one full `<observation>` XML (real title, 4–10 facts with paths, narrative). Prose is dropped.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you run claude-mem observer jobs on Grok Bot: idle/init with no tool results, or a finished searchable unit.

say_en.text: Nothing worth recording this time, skip it
say_en.note: It returns skip_summary instead of prose

say_en.text: Turn that fix into one observation
say_en.note: Outputs an observation XML with title and facts

say_en.text: Write it as a feature-type observation with file paths
say_en.note: Returns facts with paths per the observation schema
